name: Good Wood Nashville
old_description: Since 2012, we’ve built a reputation for offering unique materials that bring warmth and authenticity to every space.
about:
Good Wood Nashville, a locally owned lumber store in Nashville, Tennessee, was founded in 2012 with a focus on supplying unique wood materials that bring warmth and authenticity to spaces.

The company operates a 15,000-square-foot warehouse 1.5 miles from downtown Nashville, stocking a curated selection of premium dimensional lumber, hardwood flooring, live-edge slabs, mantels, beam wraps, reclaimed barnwood, plywood, and Festool brand tools. It supplies materials for new construction and historic renovations, and provides turn-key installation on select projects, with national shipping across the United States.

Good Wood Nashville serves homeowners, custom home builders, interior designers, contractors, architects, DIY enthusiasts, and woodworkers across Nashville, Middle Tennessee, and nationwide. Its materials have been used in projects ranging from full home remodels and commercial space fit-outs to mantel installations.

The company emphasizes American-sourced, tariff-free materials, highlighting a curated selection chosen for quality, character, and timeless appeal, with a team knowledgeable about every board.
